_help: Rules for protect_kicad_v2.py. Order: allow > deny > ask. Globs: ** crosses folders, * and ? do not cross '/'. Matching is case-insensitive on '/'-normalized paths. Edit this file to change protection; no code change needed. Optional keys: write_all and write_last add shell commands (lower-case names) whose path arguments, or last argument, are treated as written. Keep allow globs narrow: they win over deny and ask.
